abstract: Rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) support affordable disease diagnosis. Machine learning (ML) can improve RDT interpretation but often relies on large, proprietary, and costly real-world image libraries. We present SynSight – a ML-enabled RDT segmentation and classification pipeline trained on synthetic data. Validated on HIV (98% sensitivity, 99% specificity) and COVID-19 RDTs (up to 99% accuracy), SynSight enables rapid ML training without real-world training images, keeping pace with new RDT development.

title: Weakly supervised deep learning predicts perineural invasion from H&E whole-slide images in tongue squamous cell carcinoma: development and external validation.
source: PubMed · International journal of medical informatics
zh_title: 弱监督深度学习从H&E全切片预测舌鳞癌神经侵犯
summary: 两中心回顾性研究开发弱监督全切片模型预测舌鳞癌神经侵犯，并在独立外部队列验证。

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Perineural invasion (PNI) in tongue squamous cell carcinoma (TSCC) is associated with aggressive behavior and poor outcomes, yet it can be under-recognized on H&E sections because it is often focal and interpretation varies. Manual assessment of PNI suffers from significant interobserver variability, motivating AI-based decision support. We developed and externally validated a weakly supervised WSI model to predict PNI in TSCC. We retrospectively analyzed 1,511 digitized H&E whole-slide images from 629 patients at two centers. Patient-level partitioning yielded an internal training cohort of 305 patients and 787 WSIs, an internal validation cohort of 132 patients and 340 WSIs, and an external test cohort of 192 patients and 384 WSIs. Non-overlapping tiling generated 41,552,500 candidate patches before tissue-background exclusion, of which 7,813,555 unique tissue patches were retained for analysis. A two-stage pipeline was used: patch-level modeling and MIL-based slide aggregation. ResNet50 was selected over Inception_v3 and SimpleViT as the feature extractor. Patch-level prediction probabilities and image features were aggregated into a 101-dimensional patch likelihood histogram (PLH) and a 101-dimensional visual bag-of-words (BoW) representation, respectively. For conventional classifiers, the two representations were concatenated into a 202-dimensional vector, followed by z-score normalization and LASSO feature selection. For the Transformer, the two representations were processed separately using PCA, independently projected into 128-dimensional embedding spaces, and integrated using four-head cross-attention. Performance was assessed by ROC, decision curve analysis (DCA), and calibration. The internal training, internal validation, and external test cohorts included 305, 132, and 192 patients, respectively. PNI prevalence was 82.3%, 79.5%, and 72.9% in these cohorts, respectively. The Transformer fusion model achieved AUCs of 0.990 in the training cohort, 0.968 in the internal validation cohort, and 0.940 in the external test cohort. Calibration and decision curve analysis were used to characterize the model's predicted probabilities and modeled net benefit in the retrospective study cohorts. Patch-level Grad-CAM was used to generate qualitative saliency visualisations associated with ResNet50 patch-level PNI scores. This externally validated computational pathology application demonstrated retrospective technical feasibility for WSI-level PNI predicti
zh_abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] 舌鳞状细胞癌（TSCC）中的神经周围侵犯（PNI）与侵袭性行为和不良结局相关，但由于其常为局灶性且判读存在差异，在 H&E 切片上可能被低估。PNI 的人工评估存在显著的观察者间变异，促使采用基于 AI 的决策支持。我们开发并外部验证了一种弱监督 WSI 模型，用于预测 TSCC 中的 PNI。我们回顾性分析了来自两个中心 629 名患者的 1,511 张数字化 H&E 全切片图像（WSI）。患者水平划分得到内部训练队列 305 名患者和 787 张 WSI、内部验证队列 132 名患者和 340 张 WSI，以及外部测试队列 192 名患者和 384 张 WSI。非重叠切块在排除组织-背景前生成 41,552,500 个候选图像块，其中保留 7,813,555 个唯一组织图像块用于分析。采用两阶段流程：图像块级建模和基于 MIL 的切片聚合。选择 ResNet50 而非 Inception_v3 和 SimpleViT 作为特征提取器。图像块级预测概率和图像特征分别聚合为 101 维图像块似然直方图（PLH）和 101 维视觉词袋（BoW）表示。对于传统分类器，两种表示拼接为 202 维向量，随后进行 z-score 归一化和 LASSO 特征选择。对于 Transformer，两种表示分别使用 PCA 处理，独立投影到 128 维嵌入空间，并使用四头交叉注意力进行整合。通过 ROC、决策曲线分析（DCA）和校准评估性能。内部训练、内部验证和外部测试队列分别包括 305、132 和 192 名患者。这些队列中 PNI 患病率分别为 82.3%、79.5% 和 72.9%。Transformer 融合模型在训练队列、内部验证队列和外部测试队列中分别达到 AUC 0.990、0.968 和 0.940。使用校准和决策曲线分析来表征模型在回顾性研究队列中的预测概率和建模净获益。使用图像块级 Grad-CAM 生成与 ResNet50 图像块级 PNI 评分相关的定性显著性可视化。这项经外部验证的计算病理学应用在回顾性研究中证明了 WSI 水平 PNI 预测的技术可行性

abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping cardiovascular medicine by transforming routinely collected clinical data into tools for earlier disease detection and more precise phenotyping. Heart failure (HF) represents a particularly compelling opportunity for AI-driven innovation, as many patients with structural heart disease remain unrecognized and traditional diagnostic frameworks often fail to capture disease heterogeneity. AI-enabled electrocardiogram (ECG) models, including EchoNext and PRESENT-SHD, highlight the potential for scalable opportunistic screening strategies for structural heart disease. Multimodal approaches, using ECGs and echocardiograms, are enabling earlier recognition of specific HF phenotypes, such as transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis. Successful implementation of these technologies will require prospective evaluation, thoughtful workflow integration, and responsible deployment. Early-career cardiologists are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation of AI in clinical medicine, ensuring that AI serves as a tool to augment clinical reasoning and ultimately advances more personalized, patient-centered cardiovascular care.
zh_abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] 人工智能（AI）正在重塑心血管医学，将常规收集的临床数据转化为更早发现疾病和更精准表型分型的工具。心力衰竭（HF）为AI驱动的创新提供了尤其有吸引力的机会，因为许多结构性心脏病患者仍未被识别，而传统诊断框架往往无法捕捉疾病异质性。AI赋能的心电图（ECG）模型，包括 EchoNext 和 PRESENT-SHD，凸显了针对结构性心脏病开展可扩展机会性筛查策略的潜力。使用ECG和超声心动图的多模态方法正在使特定HF表型（如转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变性）的更早识别成为可能。这些技术的成功实施将需要前瞻性评估、审慎的工作流程整合和负责任的部署。处于职业生涯早期的心脏病科医生具有独特优势，可引领AI在临床医学中的这一转变，确保AI作为增强临床推理的工具，并最终推动更加个性化、以患者为中心的心血管诊疗。

title: Artificial intelligence for cerebrovascular digital subtraction angiography: methods, evidence, and challenges.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology
zh_title: 脑血管数字减影血管造影AI方法、证据与挑战综述
summary: 该结构式主题综述汇总AI在2D、三维旋转及4D DSA脑血管图像分析中的方法、证据与验证差异。
key_points: 覆盖2D DSA、3D旋转造影与4D DSA
指出证据分散于不同任务、数据集与验证策略
为结构化主题综述，非原始研究
reason: 综述类文章上限6分，覆盖面广但无新证据，属值得一看档
abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] Cerebrovascular diseases remain a major cause of mortality and long-term disability worldwide. Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) provides high-spatiotemporal-resolution visualization of cerebrovascular anatomy and contrast-agent dynamics and plays an important role in diagnosis, interventional treatment planning, and treatment assessment. Artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly been applied to cerebrovascular DSA, yet the available evidence is distributed across diverse imaging settings, technical tasks, datasets, and validation strategies. This structured topical review provides a DSA-centered overview of AI-assisted cerebrovascular image analysis across 2D DSA, three-dimensional rotational angiography, and four-dimensional DSA. Literature from Web of Science Core Collection and major engineering databases was screened at title, abstract, and full-text levels using predefined eligibility criteria. The literature is organized around six interconnected tasks: image preprocessing, vessel and lesion segmentation, image registration, reconstruction and generation, disease diagnosis and detection, and hemodynamic analysis. Representative conventional and learning-based methods are reviewed together with their datasets, evaluation metrics, validation designs, and available data or code resources, with particular attention to the strength and limitations of the supporting evidence. Recent studies demonstrate increasing use of spatiotemporal modeling, deep learning, and image-generation techniques, but clinical translation remains constrained by small or single-center datasets, heterogeneous acquisition protocols and evaluation practices, limited external and prospective validation, model interpretability, and deployment requirements. Future work should emphasize acquisition-aware and physics-informed modeling, multicenter and privacy-preserving collaboration, clinically meaningful validation, and closer integration with neurointerventional workflows. By linking methodological developments with their supporting evidence and translational challenges, this review aims to support the development of more robust and clinically applicable AI methods for cerebrovascular DSA.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 脑血管疾病仍然是全球死亡和长期残疾的主要原因。数字减影血管造影（DSA）可提供脑血管解剖结构和对比剂动力学的高时空分辨率可视化，并在诊断、介入治疗计划和治疗评估中发挥重要作用。人工智能（AI）已越来越多地应用于脑血管 DSA，但现有证据分散于不同的成像环境、技术任务、数据集和验证策略中。这篇结构化专题综述以 DSA 为中心，概述了二维 DSA、三维旋转血管造影和四维 DSA 中 AI 辅助的脑血管图像分析。来自 Web of Science Core Collection 和主要工程数据库的文献使用预定义的合格标准在标题、摘要和全文层面进行筛选。文献围绕六项相互关联的任务进行组织：图像预处理、血管和病灶分割、图像配准、重建与生成、疾病诊断与检测以及血流动力学分析。综述了代表性的传统方法和基于学习的方法及其数据集、评价指标、验证设计以及可获取的数据或代码资源，特别关注支持证据的优势与局限性。近期研究表明，时空建模、深度学习和图像生成技术的使用日益增多，但临床转化仍受限于小型或单中心数据集、异质性采集方案与评价实践、有限的外部验证和前瞻性验证、模型可解释性以及部署要求。未来工作应强调采集感知和物理知情建模、多中心和隐私保护协作、具有临床意义的验证，以及与神经介入工作流程更紧密的结合。通过将方法学进展与其支持证据和转化挑战相联系，本综述旨在支持开发更稳健、更具临床适用性的脑血管 DSA AI 方法。

title: PhysioWave-T: Token-Efficient Wavelet Foundation Models for Biosignals
zh_title: PhysioWave-T：面向生理信号的高效小波基础模型
summary: 提出面向EEG、ECG、sEMG的令牌高效小波基础模型，压缩序列长度并在多项EEG基准与癫痫检测上超过对照。
key_points: 小波尺度折叠压缩令牌序列
EEG模型30M参数、预训练超15M窗口
9项EEG指标中8项领先，并优于LUNA-L
reason: 预印本新方法，大规模预训练与多基线对比，但缺外部临床验证
abstract: We present PhysioWave-T, a token-efficient wavelet foundation model family for EEG, ECG, and sEMG. Dynamic scale folding recombines J+1 wavelet subbands prior to tokenization, compressing sequence length from (J+1)CS to CS tokens for J levels, C channels, and S temporal patches. Route-specific front ends and learned channel-name embeddings allow one Transformer per modality to handle diverse montages and sampling rates, while unseen setups reuse the backbone via lightweight adapters. We pre-train a 30M-parameter EEG model on over 15M windows (19--128 channels), alongside ECG (30M) and sEMG (12M) encoders. Across four EEG routes, scale folding cuts Transformer latency by 4.0--7.2x and peak memory by 6.8--12.7x over scale expansion without accuracy loss. Our EEG encoder leads 8 of 9 metrics against BENDR, BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and surpasses LUNA-L on wearable seizure detection with fewer parameters. Reliability-aware latent fusion (RALF) further integrates summary tokens from independently pre-trained encoders via sample-adaptive weights. On SeizeIT2, RALF raises event sensitivity at 11 false alarms/h from 61.4% to 74.4% and window AUPRC from 0.321 to 0.399 over the best unimodal baseline, outperforming weighted-logit and concatenation fusion across all variants. PhysioWave-T also achieves state-of-the-art sEMG accuracies and top macro-F1 on PTB-XL Super and Chapman-Shaoxing. Code and models: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave.
zh_abstract: 我们提出PhysioWave-T，这是一个面向EEG、ECG和sEMG的令牌高效小波基础模型系列。动态尺度折叠在令牌化之前重组J+1个小波子带，在J个层级、C个通道和S个时间块下，将序列长度从(J+1)CS个令牌压缩至CS个令牌。路由特定的前端和学习到的通道名称嵌入使每种模态的一个Transformer能够处理不同的导联组合和采样率，而未见过的设置可通过轻量级适配器复用主干网络。我们在超过1500万个窗口（19–128个通道）上预训练了一个3000万参数的EEG模型，并同时预训练了ECG（3000万参数）和sEMG（1200万参数）编码器。在四条EEG路径上，与尺度扩展相比，尺度折叠将Transformer延迟降低4.0–7.2倍，峰值内存降低6.8–12.7倍，且不损失准确率。我们的EEG编码器在9项指标中的8项上领先于BENDR、BIOT、LaBraM和EEGPT，并在可穿戴癫痫发作检测中以更少参数超过LUNA-L。可靠性感知潜在融合（RALF）进一步通过样本自适应权重整合来自独立预训练编码器的汇总令牌。在SeizeIT2上，相对于最佳单模态基线，RALF将每小时11次误报下的事件灵敏度从61.4%提高到74.4%，并将窗口AUPRC从0.321提高到0.399，在所有变体中均优于加权logit融合和拼接融合。PhysioWave-T还取得了最先进的sEMG准确率，并在PTB-XL Super和Chapman-Shaoxing上取得最高macro-F1。代码和模型：https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave。

title: Ninety-Six Ways to Measure a Scribe: Fragmented Evaluation of Ambient Scribes in Healthcare
zh_title: 环境AI scribe评估指标碎片化：96种测量方式
summary: 分析54项环境AI scribe评估研究，识别10个维度、40项指标和96种操作化方式，评估高度碎片化。
key_points: 54项研究归纳10个评估维度
40项指标被96种方式操作化
文书效率/时间最常测，安全与结局最少
reason: 预印本综述54项研究，揭示评估碎片化，有信息量但非系统综述
abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes have moved rapidly from experimental pilots to enterprise-wide deployment across health systems, promising reduced documentation burden and improved clinician experience. While research evaluating these tools has expanded quickly, there are no agreed-upon protocols or standardized metrics for assessing their performance, making it difficult to compare findings or cumulatively synthesize evidence across studies. Across 54 recent evaluation studies, we identify ten evaluation dimensions and 40 distinct metrics, operationalized in 96 different ways-35 of them (36%) used by only a single study. Assessment is dominated by documentation efficiency and time, measured in 44 of 54 studies. The other dimensions appear at broadly similar rates (16-24 studies each), and safety and clinical outcome least consistently of all. Ripple effects on the broader care system, such as impact on patients' care outcomes, redistribution of work, changes in billing and coding intensity, and downstream use of notes by other clinicians are rarely assessed. Moreover, the metrics used rely heavily on self-report and are fragmented and inconsistently operationalized, which limits comparability and hinders synthesis across studies. As an effort to support more rigorous and cumulative evaluation, in this paper we review the study designs, data sources, and metrics commonly used to evaluate ambient AI scribes in healthcare settings, discuss the limitations of current evaluation practice, and argue for a more holistic approach grounded in a standardized, multi-dimensional set of metrics.
zh_abstract: 环境人工智能（AI）记录助手已迅速从实验性试点走向卫生系统中的企业级部署，有望减轻文书负担并改善临床医生体验。尽管评估这些工具的研究迅速扩展，但目前尚无公认的方案或标准化指标来评估其性能，这使得比较研究结果或跨研究累积综合证据变得困难。在54项近期评估研究中，我们识别出十个评估维度和40项不同指标，这些指标以96种不同方式操作化——其中35项（36%）仅被一项研究使用。评估以文书效率和时间为主，在54项研究中有44项测量了这些方面。其他维度的出现率大致相似（各16–24项研究），而安全性和临床结局在所有维度中最不一致。对更广泛照护系统的连锁影响，例如对患者照护结局的影响、工作重新分配、计费和编码强度的变化，以及其他临床医生对记录的下游使用，很少被评估。此外，所用指标严重依赖自我报告，且碎片化、操作化不一致，这限制了可比性并阻碍了跨研究的综合。为支持更严谨和累积性的评估，本文综述了医疗环境中评估环境AI记录助手常用的研究设计、数据来源和指标，讨论了当前评估实践的局限性，并主张采用以标准化、多维度指标集为基础的更整体化方法。

title: Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?
zh_title: 医学影像的权重空间编程：不再需要训练数据？
summary: 预印本让大模型直接写出医学图像分类器权重，在7个任务4种模态上与零样本MedSigLIP及常规训练模型比较。
key_points: LLM一次回复直接生成LeNet式网络参数
对照零样本MedSigLIP与Adam训练基线
覆盖胸片、乳腺超声、腹部CT与盆腔MRI
reason: 预印本方法新颖且有明确基线对比，但仅在公开基准上评估，给6分
abstract: Can a large language model (LLM) write the parameters of a medical image classifier from medical knowledge alone, without any training data? Such classifiers normally require labelled images, which are costly and often unavailable. We investigate this question through weight-space programming (WSP), in which an LLM writes or adapts the weights and biases of a neural network directly, without optimisation on training data. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra each generate the parameters of a small LeNet-style CNN in a single reply, without tool use and without access to any image. We compare these networks against zero-shot MedSigLIP and against the same architecture trained on labels using the Adam optimiser, across 7 classification tasks in four modalities: chest X-ray, breast ultrasound and abdominal CT (all from MedMNIST), and pelvic MRI (SynthUterus). The LLM-written networks perform above chance on all six MedMNIST tasks, with a mean test AUC of 0.719 for Opus and 0.711 for Astra. Both models outperform MedSigLIP on 5 of 6 tasks while using more than 10,000 times fewer parameters. However, the same network trained with Adam on only 256 labelled images achieves a higher AUC on every MedMNIST task (mean AUC 0.828). On SynthUterus, Opus attains an AUC of 0.764, whereas Astra falls below chance (AUC 0.136) owing to a systematic error. These results show that LLMs can write functional medical classifiers, but that they do not yet replace training data. We release the protocol, logs and all generated weights at https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能否仅凭医学知识、在没有任何训练数据的情况下写出医学图像分类器的参数？此类分类器通常需要标注图像，而标注图像成本高昂且常常不可获得。我们通过权重空间编程（WSP）研究这一问题：在该方法中，LLM 直接写出或调整神经网络的权重与偏置，而不在训练数据上进行优化。Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra 各自在单次回复中生成一个小型 LeNet 风格 CNN 的参数，不使用工具，也无法访问任何图像。我们在四种模态的 7 个分类任务上，将这些网络与零样本 MedSigLIP 以及使用 Adam 优化器在标签上训练的相同架构进行比较：胸部 X 线、乳腺超声和腹部 CT（均来自 MedMNIST），以及盆腔 MRI（SynthUterus）。LLM 写出的网络在全部六个 MedMNIST 任务上均高于随机水平，Opus 和 Astra 的平均测试 AUC 分别为 0.719 和 0.711。两个模型在 6 个任务中的 5 个上优于 MedSigLIP，同时使用的参数少超过 10,000 倍。然而，相同网络仅使用 256 张标注图像通过 Adam 训练，就在每个 MedMNIST 任务上取得更高的 AUC（平均 AUC 0.828）。在 SynthUterus 上，Opus 达到 AUC 0.764，而 Astra 由于系统性错误而低于随机水平（AUC 0.136）。这些结果表明，LLM 能够写出功能性的医学分类器，但尚不能取代训练数据。我们在 https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical 发布协议、日志和所有生成的权重。

title: LLM-Supported Pain Neuroscience Education for Physiotherapy Students
zh_title: 大模型反馈用于物理治疗学生疼痛教育试验
summary: 一项随机对照试验注册：在四周疼痛神经科学教育中加入LLM结构化反馈，比较学生疼痛解释能力。
key_points: 120名物理治疗本科生，随机对照设计
对照为专家制定的非AI标准化反馈
主要结局为疼痛解释能力，尚无结果
reason: RCT设计但仅注册无结果、样本120人且为教育结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: İsmail Palalı; conditions: Pain, Chronic Pain, Health Professions Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: COMPLETED] Physiotherapists need to explain pain to patients in a way that is scientifically accurate, understandable, and non-threatening. Pain neuroscience education (PNE) improves students' pain knowledge, but it is unclear whether this translates into retained ability to explain pain to patients. This randomized controlled trial tested whether adding structured feedback from a large language model (LLM; GPT-5.2 Instant, OpenAI, via the ChatGPT interface) to a standardized four-week PNE programme improves undergraduate physiotherapy students' pain-explanation competence compared with the same programme using standardized expert-developed (non-AI) feedback. The primary outcome was Pain Explanation Competence (PEC) on a previously unseen clinical transfer scenario, assessed without AI access 12 weeks after the intervention by three assessors blinded to group allocation.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：İsmail Palalı；疾病/状况：疼痛、慢性疼痛、卫生专业教育；类型：INTERVENTIONAL（干预性）；阶段：NA（不适用）；入组人数：120；状态：COMPLETED（已完成）] 物理治疗师需要以科学准确、易于理解且不具威胁性的方式向患者解释疼痛。疼痛神经科学教育（PNE）可提高学生的疼痛知识，但尚不清楚这是否转化为向患者解释疼痛能力的保持。本随机对照试验测试：在标准化为期四周的PNE项目基础上，加入来自大型语言模型（LLM；GPT-5.2 Instant，OpenAI，通过ChatGPT界面）的结构化反馈，与使用标准化专家制定（非AI）反馈的同一项目相比，是否能改善本科物理治疗学生的疼痛解释能力。主要结局为在先前未见的临床迁移场景中的疼痛解释能力（Pain Explanation Competence，PEC），于干预后12周在无法使用AI的情况下由三名对分组分配设盲的评估者进行评估。

zh_title: AI 辅助影像用于局灶性肝病变诊疗：万人试验注册

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Sun Yat-sen University; conditions: Focal Liver Lesions; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 10000; status: RECRUITING] This study aims to evaluate the clinical value of artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted medical imaging in the diagnosis and management of focal liver lesions. Accurate diagnosis of focal liver lesions is important for selecting appropriate treatment strategies. However, distinguishing between different types of liver lesions can be challenging because of overlapping imaging features. AI-based imaging systems may help improve diagnostic accuracy and support clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：中山大学；疾病：局灶性肝脏病变；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组：10000；状态：招募中] 本研究旨在评估人工智能（AI）辅助医学影像在局灶性肝脏病变诊断和管理中的临床价值。局灶性肝脏病变的准确诊断对于选择适当治疗策略很重要。然而，由于影像特征重叠，区分不同类型的肝脏病变可能具有挑战性。基于AI的影像系统可能有助于提高诊断准确性并支持临床决策。

title: SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
zh_title: SkinMind：面向皮肤科的多模态智能体检索增强框架
summary: 预印本提出SkinMind多模态智能体RAG框架，借图探查工具迭代检索文本与视觉证据以支撑皮肤科判读。
key_points: 编排器与图环境迭代交互完成检索
八类分层图探查工具支持多跳取证
针对皮肤科异质文本与图像证据
reason: 预印本方法有新意，但仅见方法描述、缺乏验证细节，给5分
abstract: Reliable dermatology AI requires access to verifiable evidence distributed across heterogeneous textual and visual sources. However, conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically relies on one-shot retrieval from flat corpora, limiting its ability to adapt retrieval granularity, explore multi-hop relations, and integrate multimodal clinical evidence. We introduce SkinMind, a multimodal agentic RAG framework that equips policy models with human-inspired graph probing for autonomous evidence seeking. SkinMind organizes retrieval as an iterative interaction between an orchestrator and a graph environment. Through eight hierarchical graph-probing tools, the orchestrator progressively identifies relevant entities, inspects node-level information, traverses relations and paths, and retrieves source-text and visual evidence. This progressive-disclosure design allows the model to adaptively determine the retrieval modality, exploration direction, and evidence granularity while constructing a query-specific evidence subgraph. To support autonomous graph probing, we construct SkinMind-KG from a 62M-token corpus of dermatology guidelines and textbooks and 423K images, guided by a dermatologist-informed schema and a conflict-resolution mechanism. The resulting graph contains over 1.0M nodes and 2.0M edges, unifying textual, relational, and visual evidence for retrieval. Across six dermatology VQA benchmarks and two policy-model settings, SkinMind improves the average score over direct answering by 8.70 and 8.89 points with GPT-5.4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash, respectively, while consistently outperforming competing RAG methods. Together, SkinMind and SkinMind-KG provide an effective foundation for evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning in dermatology.
zh_abstract: 可靠皮肤病学 AI 需要获取分布于异质文本与视觉来源中的可验证证据。然而，传统检索增强生成（RAG）通常依赖对扁平语料库的一次性检索，限制了其调整检索粒度、探索多跳关系以及整合多模态临床证据的能力。我们提出 SkinMind，一种多模态智能体式 RAG 框架，为策略模型配备受人类启发的图探查能力，以实现自主证据寻求。SkinMind 将检索组织为编排器与图环境之间的迭代交互。通过八种分层图探查工具，编排器逐步识别相关实体、检查节点级信息、遍历关系与路径，并检索源文本与视觉证据。这种渐进披露设计使模型能够在构建查询特定证据子图的同时，自适应地确定检索模态、探索方向与证据粒度。为支持自主图探查，我们基于一个包含 62M token 的皮肤病学指南与教科书语料库以及 423K 张图像构建 SkinMind-KG，并以皮肤病学家知情模式（schema）和冲突解决机制为指导。所得图包含超过 1.0M 个节点和 2.0M 条边，统一文本、关系与视觉证据以供检索。在六个皮肤病学 VQA 基准和两种策略模型设置下，SkinMind 相较于直接回答，在使用 GPT-5.4-mini 和 Gemini-2.5-Flash 时平均分数分别提高 8.70 分和 8.89 分，同时持续优于竞争性 RAG 方法。总之，SkinMind 与 SkinMind-KG 为皮肤病学中基于证据的多模态推理提供了有效基础。

title: Natural-language cohort queries on a hospital data platform: accuracy and provenance in a real-world evaluation
zh_title: 医院数据平台自然语言队列查询真实世界评估
summary: 在多家三级医院评估商业自然语言查询平台，用25条提示检验脑肿瘤队列识别准确性与查询溯源。
key_points: AIRE平台接入机构健康数据平台
25条自然语言提示对比人工SQL
评估队列识别准确性与查询级溯源
reason: 真实世界预印本评估，25条提示单队列，外部验证有限
abstract: Background: Accessing routinely collected clinical data for research remains technically demanding across heterogeneous hospital systems. This proof-of-concept study aimed to evaluate the accuracy and query-level traceability of a commercial natural-language (NL) data-query platform implemented at a university hospital. Methods: An on-premises data integration platform with an NL query interface (AIRE; Briya, Tel Aviv, Israel) was connected to the institutional health data platform across three tertiary-care hospitals under an approved pseudonymization and governance framework. Implementation comprised regulatory and governance approval, and IT deployment. Twenty-five NL prompts addressing cohort identification and characterization in an adult ICD-10 C71-coded brain-tumor cohort (n = 1,594) were evaluated against manually written reference SQL and checked for a corresponding executed query in the exported log. Responses were classified into five categories. Prompts with unanswered or incorrect responses were re-posed in a new thread. Results: The platform was implemented over two years. Fifteen of 25 responses were exact (n = 11), concordant after definition alignment (n = 1), or incorrect but traceable from the logged SQL (n = 3); six were plausible but incorrect without a logged query, and four remained unanswered. No incorrect unlogged result recurred in a new thread. Across the initial and repeat evaluations, 22 of 23 logged responses were correct or traceable, whereas all eight unlogged responses were incorrect. Conclusions: Implementation was feasible but required substantial local institutional preparation. The NL interface reproduced SQL-derived results when definitions were explicit, while query-level provenance and verification of the displayed result were critical for identifying unreliable outputs.
zh_abstract: 【背景】在异质性医院系统中，获取常规收集的临床数据用于研究在技术上仍然困难。本概念验证研究旨在评估在大学医院实施的商业化自然语言（NL）数据查询平台的准确性及查询级可追溯性。【方法】在获批的假名化和治理框架下，将一个具有自然语言查询界面的本地部署数据集成平台（AIRE；Briya，以色列特拉维夫）连接到跨三家三级医院的机构健康数据平台。实施包括监管和治理审批以及IT部署。针对成人 ICD-10 C71 编码的脑肿瘤队列（n = 1,594）中队列识别和特征描述的25条自然语言提示，与人工编写的参考SQL进行对照评估，并在导出的日志中检查是否存在相应的已执行查询。回答被分为五类。未回答或回答错误的提示在一个新线程中重新提出。【结果】该平台部署耗时两年。25条回答中，15条为完全一致（n = 11）、定义对齐后一致（n = 1），或错误但可从记录SQL追溯（n = 3）；6条看似合理但错误且无记录查询，4条仍未回答。在新线程中未再出现错误的未记录结果。在初始和重复评估中，23条有记录回答中有22条正确或可追溯，而所有8条无记录回答均错误。【结论】实施可行，但需要大量本地机构准备工作。当定义明确时，自然语言界面可重现SQL得出的结果，而查询级来源和所显示结果的验证对于识别不可靠输出至关重要。

title: Risk prediction models for macrovascular complications in type 2 diabetes mellitus: from traditional risk scores to multimodal intelligent prediction.
zh_title: 2型糖尿病大血管并发症风险预测模型综述
summary: 综述从传统评分到机器学习、深度学习及多模态AI的T2DM大血管并发症风险预测模型及其局限。
key_points: 梳理传统评分至多模态AI模型演进
指出人群异质、结局定义不一等问题
强调外部验证、可解释性与落地不足
reason: 同行评审综述，覆盖多模态AI但非系统综述，证据级别有限
abstract: [Frontiers in endocrinology] Macrovascular complications are the leading cause of morbidity and mortality in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Early risk identification and accurate risk stratification are essential for both primary and secondary cardiovascular prevention. With the rapid development of electronic health records, medical imaging, multi-omics technologies, and artificial intelligence (AI), risk prediction models for diabetic macrovascular complications have evolved from traditional statistical approaches to machine learning-, deep learning-, and multimodal AI-driven models. However, despite substantial improvements in predictive performance, current models remain limited by heterogeneous target populations, inconsistent outcome definitions, insufficient external validation, limited clinical interpretability, and inadequate real-world implementation, thereby restricting their clinical translation. This review summarizes the evolution, data sources, modeling methodologies, clinical applications, and future perspectives of risk prediction models for macrovascular complications in T2DM. We first describe the transition from conventional cardiovascular risk scores, including the Framingham Risk Score, to diabetes-specific models such as the UKPDS Risk Engine, ADVANCE, RECODe, and SCORE2-Diabetes, followed by the emergence of AI-based prediction models. We then review the major data sources used in contemporary prediction models, including clinical characteristics, laboratory biomarkers, vascular function and imaging, multi-omics profiles, and wearable device-derived data. Furthermore, we compare the strengths and limitations of traditional statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, and multitask learning with respect to predictive performance, interpretability, and clinical applicability, and discuss the major challenges related to study design, external validation, data quality, algorithmic bias, and real-world implementation. Finally, we propose that future risk prediction models for diabetic macrovascular complications will evolve from single-source data to multimodal data integration, from static risk estimation to dynamic risk trajectories, from single outcomes to multiple interconnected cardiovascular outcomes, from prognosis prediction to individualized treatment benefit prediction, and from standalone algorithms to continuously learning clinical decision support systems. Emerging technologies, including foundation models, large language models
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in endocrinology] 大血管并发症是2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者发病和死亡的主要原因。早期风险识别和准确的风险分层对于心血管疾病的一级和二级预防都至关重要。随着电子健康记录、医学影像、多组学技术和人工智能（AI）的快速发展，糖尿病大血管并发症的风险预测模型已从传统统计方法发展为机器学习、深度学习和多模态AI驱动的模型。然而，尽管预测性能有了实质性提升，当前模型仍受限于目标人群异质性、结局定义不一致、外部验证不足、临床可解释性有限以及真实世界实施不充分，从而限制了其临床转化。本综述总结了T2DM大血管并发症风险预测模型的演变、数据来源、建模方法、临床应用和未来展望。我们首先描述从传统心血管风险评分（包括Framingham风险评分）向糖尿病特异性模型（如UKPDS Risk Engine、ADVANCE、RECODe和SCORE2-Diabetes）的转变，随后介绍基于AI的预测模型的出现。然后，我们综述当代预测模型使用的主要数据来源，包括临床特征、实验室生物标志物、血管功能和影像、多组学特征以及可穿戴设备衍生数据。此外，我们比较传统统计方法、机器学习、深度学习和多任务学习在预测性能、可解释性和临床适用性方面的优势与局限，并讨论与研究设计、外部验证、数据质量、算法偏倚和真实世界实施相关的主要挑战。最后，我们提出糖尿病大血管并发症的未来风险预测模型将从单一来源数据走向多模态数据整合，从静态风险估计走向动态风险轨迹，从单一结局走向多个相互关联的心血管结局，从预后预测走向个体化治疗获益预测，从独立算法走向持续学习的临床决策支持系统。包括基础模型、大语言模型在内的新兴技术

abstract: In clinical datasets, data augmentation is often avoided because it can remove important unusual values, known as outliers, which are important for understanding diseases accurately. However, clinical EEG datasets often suffer from two key limitations: small sample sizes and class imbalance, which significantly reduce classification performance. To overcome these challenges, this study applies generative AI-based data augmentation techniques with a carefully designed hybrid pipeline that effectively enhances performance even on limited EEG data. Using EEG signals from 50 brain stroke patients, we investigate both traditional oversampling methods (SMOTE and ADASYN) and advanced generative models, including WGAN and WGAN-GP. Our proposed pipeline involves preprocessing EEG recordings, extracting comprehensive statistical and frequency-domain features, applying feature reduction, and evaluating multiple machine learning classifiers. Experimental results show that the combination of SelectKBest feature selection, SVM classifier, and WGAN-GP augmentation achieves the highest classification accuracy of 72%, outperforming other methods. This work introduces a novel hybrid approach for EEG-based stroke severity classification, demonstrating that generative augmentation, when integrated properly, can significantly improve performance on small clinical datasets. To the best of our knowledge, this combination of techniques has not been explored before on any dataset, providing a solid foundation for future research in automated EEG-based stroke diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 在临床数据集中，数据增强常被避免，因为它可能去除重要的不寻常值，即异常值，而这些值对于准确理解疾病很重要。然而，临床 EEG 数据集常受两个关键限制：样本量小和类别不平衡，这会显著降低分类性能。为克服这些挑战，本研究应用基于生成式 AI 的数据增强技术，并采用精心设计的混合流程，即使在有限 EEG 数据上也能有效提升性能。我们使用 50 名脑卒中患者的 EEG 信号，研究传统过采样方法（SMOTE 和 ADASYN）以及先进生成模型，包括 WGAN 和 WGAN-GP。我们提出的流程包括预处理 EEG 记录、提取全面的统计与频域特征、应用特征降维，并评估多种机器学习分类器。实验结果表明，SelectKBest 特征选择、SVM 分类器和 WGAN-GP 增强的组合达到最高分类准确率 72%，优于其他方法。这项工作提出了一种用于基于 EEG 的卒中严重程度分类的新颖混合方法，证明生成式增强在适当整合后可显著改善小型临床数据集上的性能。据我们所知，这种技术组合此前尚未在任何数据集上探索过，为未来基于 EEG 的自动化卒中诊断研究提供了坚实基础。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Pancreas Carcinoma, PDAC - Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 50; status: RECRUITING] Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is associated with a poor prognosis, and early detection of pancreatic lesions is of great importance for improving patient outcomes. In this study, whole-body imaging with FDG and FAPI will be used to visualize the early development of pancreatic cancer lesions from multiple perspectives, including glucose metabolism, tumor fibrotic stroma, and integrin receptor expression. Furthermore, leveraging the advantages of four-dimensional dynamic long-axial PET imaging, artificial intelligence-assisted lesion detection and analysis will be performed to characterize lesions and differentiate between benign and malignant lesions. The imaging findings will subsequently be compared with postoperative histopathological results to evaluate the diagnostic performance of the proposed imaging approaches.

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital; conditions: Healthy Adult Participants; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 260; status: COMPLETED] The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted training works better than usual training. The training aims to improve handwashing skill in newly hired healthcare workers. The AI-assisted training uses a screen that shows feedback right away. The main questions it aims to answer are: Does AI-assisted training lead to higher overall handwashing skill scores than usual training? Does AI-assisted training improve harder handwashing steps? These include interlaced fingers, locked fingers, and fingertip rubbing. Researchers will compare AI-assisted training to usual instructor-led training. They will see if AI-assisted training improves handwashing skill. Participants will: Attend a 30-minute class on the World Health Organization (WHO) seven-step handwashing method. The class also explains how the skill test works. Be assigned by chance to usual training or AI-assisted training. Both trainings last 45 minutes. In the AI-assisted group, use a camera and screen. The screen shows their hand movements and gives feedback right away. This helps them correct their movements. Take a final handwashing skill test. The same AI system scores 12 parts of the WHO seven-step method. Two hundred sixty newly hired healthcare workers joined this study at one hospital in China. They included doctors, nurses, research staff, lab staff, and support staff.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：邵逸夫医院（Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital）；疾病/状况：健康成年参与者；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组人数：260；状态：已完成] 本临床试验的目标是了解人工智能（AI）辅助培训是否比常规培训效果更好。该培训旨在提高新入职医疗卫生工作者的洗手技能。AI辅助培训使用屏幕即时显示反馈。其主要旨在回答的问题是：AI辅助培训是否比常规培训带来更高的总体洗手技能评分？AI辅助培训是否改善较难的洗手步骤？这些步骤包括手指交叉、手指锁扣和指尖揉搓。研究人员将比较AI辅助培训与常规的讲师主导培训。他们将观察AI辅助培训是否改善洗手技能。参与者将：参加一堂30分钟的课程，学习世界卫生组织（WHO）七步洗手法。该课程还解释技能测试如何进行。被随机分配到常规培训或AI辅助培训。两种培训均持续45分钟。在AI辅助组中，使用摄像头和屏幕。屏幕显示其手部动作并即时给出反馈。这有助于他们纠正动作。参加最终的洗手技能测试。同一AI系统对WHO七步洗手法中的12个部分进行评分。260名新入职医疗卫生工作者在中国一家医院参加了本研究。他们包括医生、护士、科研人员、实验室人员和支持人员。
